newsitem.title: USA: Venture taps Solt as chief finance officer.
newsitem.headline: Venture taps Solt as chief finance officer.

text.p: Venture Stores Inc said Friday it named Russell Solt, executive vice president of finance and administration, as chief financial officer, effective July 1, 1997.
Solt succeeds Eugene Caldwell who has resigned to pursue other interests.
Venture operates 113 discount stores in nine states.
Solt has been executive vice president of finance and administration since joining Venture in December 1995.
Robert Wildrick, Venture's chairman and chief executive officer, said Solt has played a key role in financing Venture's continued repositioning as a family value retailer.
Most recently, Solt was instrumental in negotiating a three-year commitment for a new $250 million secured revolving line of credit from BT Commercial Corp, an affiliate of Bankers Trust Co, he said.
Shares of Venture were trading unchanged at 2-1/4.
